content_sections.heading: About Amrita Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is conducting this recruitment for a research project funded by the Department of Science and Technology. The position is based at the Amritapuri Campus in Kollam, Keralam, and focuses on advanced robotics research involving interactive robotic wheelchairs and collaborative robotic arms.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment offers 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post under the project. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following qualification and experience criteria set for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post. Essential Qualification: B.Tech with a minimum of 1+ years of experience.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The duration of the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position is 2 years.

content_sections.heading: Amrita Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will work on the DST-sanctioned project titled "Interactive Robotic Wheelchair with collaborative robotic arm for Proactive Interaction through Spatial Awareness in Navigation and Object Handling for Enhanced Service." Key responsibilities include: Strong multidisciplinary knowledge in various fields of robotics Experience in robotics system design, integration, and testing Hands-on experience in hardware and software development Good problem-solving and analytical skills
